name: Pre-Loading

Except this island is full of secret cameras and pool boys are expected to be gay-sex-boy-toys for the island visitors that pay big bucks to spend a vacation in this deviant paradise. Experience what it's like to be objectified and serving a powerful master while living a fantasy alongside other hot guys.
